offers_products.reason: Insurance and annuity contracts are financial services, not goods or software.

offers_services.reason: Life insurance and annuities issued by an insurer count as services.

sells_to_consumers.reason: Individuals buy annuities and life insurance for retirement and protection through agents and advisors.

sells_to_organizations.reason: Pension risk transfer group annuities are sold to corporate pension plan sponsors.

recurring_revenue.reason: Policies and annuity contracts are held long term and generate ongoing premiums and investment spread income.

cyclical_demand.reason: Insurance and retirement income products are protective and long-term, so demand is fairly steady in recessions.

big_ticket.reason: Policies are routine financial products; annuity premiums can be large but this is a judgment call.

people_delivered.reason: Value comes from insurance contracts and balance sheet backing, not from staff time.

large_customers.reason: Main buyers are individuals and households; corporate PRT clients are a smaller part.

asset_heavy.reason: An insurer needs no plants or fleets; its investment portfolio is financial, not physical.

notes: Annuity premiums can be large, so big_ticket and recurring_revenue are judgment calls.
